messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "opioids can cause sudden withdrawal symptoms"
set: ["opioids can cause sudden withdrawal symptoms", "stopping abruptly can cause serious withdrawal symptoms", "can cause withdrawal symptoms in newborn baby", "may cause life-threatening withdrawal symptoms in newborn", "prolonged use during pregnancy can cause withdrawal symptoms in newborn baby", "opioids can block pain-relieving effect", "use for extended period during pregnancy can cause life-threatening withdrawal symptoms in newborn baby", "withdrawal symptoms if stopped suddenly", "can cause premature birth", "withdrawal symptoms if combined with certain medicines", "can cause low birth weight", "stopping abruptly can cause uncontrolled pain", "misuse can cause addiction, overdose, or death", "can cause serious and life-threatening irregular heartbeat", "too much thyroid hormone can cause angina", "too much thyroid hormone can cause irregular heartbeat"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
